name: Lazer Station music changer
teaser: Changes vanilla Tarkov OST to Synthy stuff!
description_html:
My first mod! It took me about 2 hours to figure out what I was doing and to fix issues.

This mod changes the default Tarkov OST to a synth and dark synth soundtrack by Lazer Station! I have full permission to do this as well.

It may play each song twice. I’m currently looking into it.

I made this mod as a symbol of appreciation towards my father. He’s the producer of this music and I wanted to start my bumpy modding journey with something referencing someone I love. Any issues will be looked into, solutions will be uploaded if they aren’t too difficult as I am lazy and new to modding. Thank you for downloading, hell, even reading this!
